reuse: Owner authorized Kie-provided example images and prompts for the MiniMax page.
transformation: WebP display copies, maximum 1200px on either side, quality 88. Prompts are verbatim.

example.exampleTitle: Native 4K knolling photo: nine objects placed exactly in a 3×3 grid, with fine texture detail that holds up when zoomed in

input.prompt: Overhead knolling photograph on a warm light-gray linen tablecloth, shot in native 4K with every object tack-sharp. Exactly nine objects are arranged in a precise 3 by 3 grid with equal spacing, each one aligned square to the frame. Top row, left to right: a coiled brown leather camera strap, a small handheld light meter with a round analog dial, and a folded paper road map. Middle row, left to right: a red pocket notebook with a black elastic band, a silver-and-black vintage rangefinder camera exactly in the center of the image, and a chrome 50mm lens standing upright on its rear cap. Bottom row, left to right: three yellow 35mm film canisters standing side by side, a brass key on a round tan leather tag, and a pair of round tortoiseshell sunglasses folded closed. Soft, even daylight from the top left with short gentle shadows. Macro-level detail everywhere: the pebbled leather grain, the knurled metal rings and engraved distance scale on the lens, the paper fibers of the map and the weave of the linen are all crisp when zoomed in. No brand names, no logos, no emblems, no other text.

example.exampleTitle: Typographic poster in 2K: a bold headline and multi-line small text, all spelled correctly

input.prompt: Square Swiss-style typographic poster for a fictional night ferry festival on cream textured paper. In the middle, a large flat-color illustration of a small white ferry crossing a dark navy river at night, its round portholes glowing warm yellow, with long golden reflections rippling on the water and a thin crescent moon above. At the top, a huge bold condensed sans-serif headline in vermilion red reads "LANTERN FERRY" on two stacked lines, tightly kerned. Below the illustration, a thin black rule, then a two-column grid of small black text: the left column reads "OCTOBER 3–5" with "PIER 7 · HARBOR DISTRICT" beneath it; the right column lists "BOARDING 7:30 PM", "LIVE STRINGS ON DECK" and "TICKETS AT THE DOCK". At the very bottom, a small centered line reads "THREE NIGHTS / ONE RIVER / A THOUSAND LIGHTS". Strict grid alignment, generous margins, flat print-ready colors limited to navy, vermilion, warm yellow, black and cream. Every word spelled exactly as written, sharp and legible. No people, no logos.

example.exampleTitle: Hand-drawn infographic: five labeled steps in a clockwise ring around a central illustration, with accurate small text

input.prompt: A friendly editorial infographic in a warm hand-drawn gouache illustration style, horizontal layout on a cream background. Across the top, a bold rounded dark-brown title reads "THE PERFECT POUR-OVER". In the exact center, larger than everything else, a detailed illustration of a glass pour-over dripper with a paper filter sitting on a glass carafe, a thin spiral stream of water pouring from a gooseneck kettle above it and dark coffee dripping into the carafe. Around the central illustration, five numbered steps form a clockwise ring connected by a dotted arrow, starting at the upper left. Each step has a small round vignette and a short label beneath it: 1 "WEIGH 20 g BEANS" with a small kitchen scale; 2 "GRIND MEDIUM-FINE" with a wooden hand grinder; 3 "RINSE THE FILTER" with hot water over a paper filter; 4 "BLOOM FOR 30 s" with coffee grounds puffing up; 5 "POUR SLOWLY TO 320 g" with a spiral pour. Along the bottom, a slim info bar with three small icons and labels: "WATER 93 °C", "RATIO 1 : 16", "TOTAL 3:00". Muted palette of coffee brown, cream, sage green and terracotta, consistent line weight, generous spacing, every word and number exactly as written. No people, no logos.

example.exampleTitle: Day-to-night relight in 4K: the same street and café after rain, with warm window light and wet reflections

input.prompt: Turn <Picture 1> into the same street at night just after rain. Keep the architecture, the café storefront, the tables and chairs, the olive trees, the street lamp, the balconies and the camera angle exactly the same. Make the sky a deep blue just after dusk, switch on warm golden light inside the café windows and in the street lamp, add a strand of small warm bulbs glowing along the edge of the awning, and light a few balcony windows above. Make the cobblestones and sidewalk wet, with glossy reflections of the warm lights and a few small puddles. Realistic night photography with natural light falloff and soft glow around the lights. No people, no cars.
